# kramdown-rfc2629

**Tag**: serialization, tooling

## 简介

An RFCXML (RFC 799x) generating backend for Thomas Leitner's
"kramdown" markdown parser.  Mostly useful for RFC writers.

## 官网

- 主页: http://github.com/cabo/kramdown-rfc
- 文档: https://www.rubydoc.info/gems/kramdown-rfc2629/1.7.43
- RubyGems: https://rubygems.org/gems/kramdown-rfc2629
